posts.text: Every image and block of text Claude produces since August 2, 2026 carries a hidden provenance mark. Neither one traces back to you: Anthropic says both only prove "made with Claude," not who prompted it. Worse, paraphrasing or back-translating text degrades the watermark, and just re-saving or screenshotting an image destroys its C2PA credential entirely. Don't count on either for proof of authorship.
